create_customer.description: Create a new customer in ERPNext.
create_customer.name: create_customer

parameters.description: The customer's name.
parameters.name: customer_name

parameters.description: Either 'Individual' or 'Company'.
parameters.name: customer_type

parameters.description: The customer's email address.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: The customer's mobile number.
parameters.name: phone

creation.description: When it was created, in the site's time zone

customer_group.description: The customer group it belongs to

customer_type.description: The kind of customer, such as Company

disabled.description: 1 when the customer is disabled, otherwise 0

modified.description: When it last changed, in the site's time zone

owner.description: The ERPNext user who created it

territory.description: The sales territory it belongs to

parameters.description: The employee's first name.
parameters.name: employee_name

parameters.description: A Gender record in ERPNext, e.g. 'Male' or 'Female'.
parameters.name: gender

parameters.description: The employee's date of birth.
parameters.name: date_of_birth

parameters.description: The employee's start date.
parameters.name: date_of_joining

company.description: The company the employee works for

creation.description: When it was created, in the site's time zone

modified.description: When it last changed, in the site's time zone

owner.description: The ERPNext user who created it

expenses.description: Train fare to the regional trade show

parameters.description: The employee's ERPNext document name.
parameters.name: employee

parameters.description: The date the claim is posted. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: posting_date

parameters.description: The claim's expense lines; at least one is required. Each entry needs 'expense_type' (an Expense Claim Type, e.g. 'Travel') and 'amount', and may include 'sanctioned_amount', 'expense_date', 'description' and 'default_account' (needed when the expense type has no default account for the employee's company).
parameters.name: expenses

parameters.description: The user who approves the claim. Defaults to the employee's expense approver, or the connected ERPNext user.
parameters.name: expense_approver

parameters.description: A unique code identifying the item.
parameters.name: item_code

parameters.description: The item's display name.
parameters.name: item_name

parameters.description: The item group this item belongs to. Defaults to 'All Item Groups'.
parameters.name: item_group

parameters.description: Whether ERPNext tracks inventory for this item. Stock items need a warehouse on every order; turn this off for services. Defaults to ERPNext's own setting (tracked).
parameters.name: is_stock_item

create_leave_application.description: Submit a leave application for an employee.
create_leave_application.name: create_leave_application

parameters.description: The employee's ERPNext document name.
parameters.name: employee

parameters.description: The first day of leave.
parameters.name: from_date

parameters.description: The last day of leave.
parameters.name: to_date

parameters.description: The type of leave, e.g. 'Casual Leave'. Every type except 'Leave Without Pay' needs a Leave Allocation covering the dates.
parameters.name: leave_type

parameters.description: The user who approves the leave. Defaults to the employee's leave approver, or the connected ERPNext user.
parameters.name: leave_approver

create_purchase_invoice.description: Create a draft purchase invoice from a supplier.
create_purchase_invoice.name: create_purchase_invoice

parameters.description: The supplier's ERPNext document name.
parameters.name: supplier

parameters.description: The document's line items; at least one is required. Each entry needs 'item_code' and 'qty', and may include 'rate', 'warehouse', and a per-line 'delivery_date' (sales orders) or 'schedule_date' (purchase orders).
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The date the invoice is posted.
parameters.name: posting_date

create_purchase_order.description: Create a new purchase order for a supplier.
create_purchase_order.name: create_purchase_order

parameters.description: The supplier's ERPNext document name.
parameters.name: supplier

parameters.description: The document's line items; at least one is required. Each entry needs 'item_code' and 'qty', and may include 'rate', 'warehouse', and a per-line 'delivery_date' (sales orders) or 'schedule_date' (purchase orders).
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The date the order was placed. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: transaction_date

parameters.description: The date the goods are needed. Defaults to the order date.
parameters.name: schedule_date

parameters.description: The warehouse every line is received into unless it names its own. Needed for stock items when the site has no default warehouse.
parameters.name: warehouse

create_sales_invoice.description: Create a draft sales invoice for a customer.
create_sales_invoice.name: create_sales_invoice

parameters.description: The customer's ERPNext document name.
parameters.name: customer

parameters.description: The document's line items; at least one is required. Each entry needs 'item_code' and 'qty', and may include 'rate', 'warehouse', and a per-line 'delivery_date' (sales orders) or 'schedule_date' (purchase orders).
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The date the invoice is posted.
parameters.name: posting_date

parameters.description: The date payment is due.
parameters.name: due_date

creation.description: When it was created, in the site's time zone

docstatus.description: 0 for a draft, 1 once submitted, 2 once cancelled

amount.description: The line's total, its quantity times its rate

rate.description: The price of one, in the invoice's currency

modified.description: When it last changed, in the site's time zone

outstanding_amount.description: How much of it is still to be paid

owner.description: The ERPNext user who created it

status.description: The invoice's status, such as Draft or Unpaid

create_sales_order.description: Create a new sales order for a customer.
create_sales_order.name: create_sales_order

parameters.description: The customer's ERPNext document name.
parameters.name: customer

parameters.description: The document's line items; at least one is required. Each entry needs 'item_code' and 'qty', and may include 'rate', 'warehouse', and a per-line 'delivery_date' (sales orders) or 'schedule_date' (purchase orders).
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The date the order was placed.
parameters.name: transaction_date

parameters.description: The date the order is expected to be delivered.
parameters.name: delivery_date

parameters.description: The warehouse every line ships from unless it names its own. Needed for stock items when the site has no default warehouse.
parameters.name: warehouse

creation.description: When it was created, in the site's time zone

delivery_date.description: When it is to be delivered (YYYY-MM-DD)

docstatus.description: 0 for a draft, 1 once submitted, 2 once cancelled

amount.description: The line's total, its quantity times its rate

delivery_date.description: When the line is to be delivered

rate.description: The price of one, in the order's currency

modified.description: When it last changed, in the site's time zone

owner.description: The ERPNext user who created it

set_warehouse.description: The warehouse every line ships from unless it names one

status.description: The order's status, such as Draft

total_qty.description: How many units the order is for, in all

parameters.description: The sales order's ERPNext document name.
